title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Returning Client Property
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A paralegal completes a retainer involving a WSIB claim. The client's account is fully paid. The client requests their original medical records back. The paralegal's office is busy, and they tell the client it will take six months to dig the files out of storage. Is this acceptable?
options: Yes, a paralegal has discretion on when to return files.
No, a paralegal must promptly return client property to which the client is entitled upon request.
Yes, as long as the paralegal keeps digital copies.
No, the paralegal must permanently keep original records in case of LSO audits.
questions.explain: Under Rule 3.07 (Client Property), a paralegal must care for a client's property as a careful and prudent owner would and must *promptly* deliver the property to the client (or their order) upon request, provided all fees are paid and no solicitor's lien is claimed.
